notes.title: UPDATE 14 [MATCHMAKING UPDATE]
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Thanks for staying active in Doll Impostor!

Update 14 is ready! This update was planned to be a Medium update, however, the integration of some features like Matchmaking makes it a major update due to all the technical work behind it! Originally, contracts were going to be the core of this update, but they pale in comparison to the Matchmaking system.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922238/1c960e0aedddafc3e82ba9025db1aa45b5e2911c.png


 April 24th available for official content creators (Closed beta)
 April 25th available for everyone (Open beta)
 April 28th available for everyone


Even though this is a major update, there will be no trailer.

Before we start explaining the Update, I want to remind everyone where the idea for Matchmaking came from. A Doll Impostor tournament was being prepared — it was going to be the first tournament where several players competed for a prize. It couldn't happen due to missing players, mainly because of timezone issues. Some very active users are located all over the world — America, Europe, Asia — which made scheduling matches impractical. After that, I started playing 1v1 matches with players in the daily challenges, and it turned out to be really fun. So I decided to create a Matchmaking system so everyone could play 1v1 in a more legitimate, competitive, and fair way. Daily challenges could be unfair because one player might get revealing clues early while the other doesn't. That's why in Matchmaking we’ve introduced a "Seed" — this seed ensures that both players get an Impostor with the same friends (in the same order) and same likes/dislikes, even though the dolls will conveniently look different. Because it's not about the doll's skin (whether it's Daniel or Ivy), but about solving the clues despite the appearance. So welcome Matchmaking to Doll Impostor! This feature is still evolving and we’re testing how exciting/addictive it is. Many users are skeptical, but that’s normal — the same happened with the Cabin map and the Career mode, and both ended up being fan favorites. In the end, it’s all about trying new mechanics and experiences to keep things fun!

Matchmaking
Let’s start with Matchmaking. This mode unlocks once you've completed Nightmare mode on all maps. After that, you can search for matches on the maps of your choice. These are asynchronous matches — you can play your match and leave it unfinished. Another player will later join and be matched with you. The winner is the one who solves the case in the least amount of time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922238/9a893eb78a5cb8352164bb010a6e1642077fa13d.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922238/b45c14e40db7d060a9a56670fe20f6536f427b50.png

Important notes:
1. Elo works like a bet — you wager Elo to play (generally 10%, unless you’re below the minimum which guarantees at least 1 Elo even at 0 Elo).
2. You can only have up to 5 unfinished matches.
3. If your match doesn’t get paired within 48 hours, it will end and your Elo will be refunded.
4. Matches only occur when the opponent’s Elo is within ±100% of your current Elo (e.g., if you’re Elo 10, you’ll match with players between Elo 5 and 20). Otherwise, a new match will be created. [This limit may increase to 200%, 500% if there are no matches.]
5. Once a match is paired, Player 2 has a maximum of 30 minutes to complete the match. If they don't, they lose by inactivity (e.g., exiting the game or abandoning the match).
6. Elo is awarded after each match. You lose Elo for each match, with a 5 match cap to avoid high Elo players being matched with very low Elo.
7. There are matchmaking ranks tied to Elo, with 3000 Elo being the highest rank (The Awakening).

Ranks
Current matchmaking ranks are:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922238/28fccb5b7b95d9701ecdc7079cae2463bbd5530d.png

Each rank requires more Elo. You can drop ranks by playing since Elo is wagered, but you can regain Elo and even steal Elo from other players.

Contracts
You now have contracts available on your desktop. This new element gives you 3 random contracts that offer rewards in exchange for completing them. For example, you may be asked to complete the House map on Normal difficulty before 6 AM with/without the robot active. Generally, they follow a pattern: the harder it is, the more money and XP you earn. Once a contract is completed, a new one appears. Contracts cannot be canceled (they disappear when you leave the game) so they are temporary.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922238/9688844057cc995206b8b4b623f66c5bcb04807c.png

Cabin in the woods (Career mode)
The Cabin in the Woods map has been added to Career mode, with new actions!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922238/8f4cb0572779249985cd0d6374c757900b77e5ad.png

New achievements
Four new achievements have been added!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922238/bd141367c9da710c707ddd8dfb4b3de0a7622bc2.jpg

Career features
New features have been added to Career mode!


 Fuses can now blow after some time, forcing you to place a new one.
 If you play with the robot active, it can go and remove a fuse when the electricity is on (forcing you to replace it).
 The book of souls no longer reveals everything about the Impostor — it now shows only a few clues, so you must investigate more instead of relying on a single piece of evidence.


Features

 Troll phrases have been added to the signatures
 A reminder now tells you to shake to reveal the photo
 Career mode kisses can now be seen from any distance
 Fuses can now blow in career mode
 The robot can now remove fuses in career mode
 The book of souls no longer reveals everything about the Impostor (only some things)
 The Cabin in the Woods map has been added to career mode

 A demo will be released in the next few days

Fixes

 Fixed the issue where achievements weren’t awarded instantly (you had to exit the match or similar to get them)


Fixes that weren't completed during the update will be added in the following days.

P.S. The price of Doll Impostor has increased from €6.89 to €7.79 due to the new content introduced in this and upcoming updates.

notes.title: WORKING ON UPDATE 14
notes.notes:
Thank you all so much for staying active in Doll Impostor! We are continuing to develop this game! The next update brings some new features to add more content!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922238/132552b989cc8c7f16e832618a5ca00eab7fa985.png

Contracts
There will be a new feature called Contracts — these are papers that give you 3 missions at a time. Taking these contracts will cost you an initial fee, and you’ll have a time limit to complete them. If you fail, you'll get penalized financially; if you succeed, you can claim the contract reward.

It’s similar to daily challenges but gives you 3 objectives to complete within a limited time. You’ll need to wait for new contracts to refresh. For example, it might ask you to complete the House map in Nightmare mode and reward you for it. Each completed contract will be stored and displayed publicly in your lobby, showing your total number of finished contracts.

Career Mode Modifications
Some new features will be added, such as lights occasionally going out, forcing you to go and turn them back on. (You'll need to buy multiple fuses.)

The Book of Souls will no longer give all the clues, only some of them, making it harder to get the correct answer.

The Cabin map will be adapted for Career Mode!

Matchmaking
A ranked Matchmaking system will be added. You’ll be able to play asynchronous 1vs1 matches against other players. The winner is the one who completes the case in the least amount of time.

This idea came from the cancelled tournament, after which players began playing 1vs1 matches and found them interesting. This new feature will allow for competition among veterans. There will also be a podium and global ranking similar to the leaderboards, but specifically for 1vs1 matches.

Robot
The robot will gain sound perception — if you talk or activate anything noisy, it will go check it out again.

Free Sample Release
"Doll Impostor: Free Sample" will be released — a very lightweight version of the game including only the House map, the Shelter, and Classic mode. The goal of this Free Sample is to attract new players, and it will be released on Steam as a separate free game.

EDIT: Doll Impostor: Free Sample is a standalone free version designed to attract new players, since Steam gives more visibility to new releases than to demos or updates.

Minor Additions
Some troll quotes will be added to the signatures. A notification will appear telling you to shake the mouse to reveal photos in Career mode. Kisses in Career will be adjusted so they don’t disappear at long distances. Scroll functionality will be added using the right analog stick on gamepads.

New Doll Impostor Game
Finally, a new game will be launched alongside this update called *Doll Impostor: Quality Check*. Your goal will be to evaluate Doll Impostor assets — dolls, boxes, objects, etc. You’ll validate whether everything works correctly based on difficulty or needs adjustments. The game will cost around $4.99 and will include a customizer and all the latest Doll Impostor content synced with it.

Once development is complete, it will be on Steam for 1 month before going on sale. And when development is finished, Update 14 will officially be complete!

EDIT: A new standalone game will also be released: Doll Impostor: Quality Check. This is not a beta version of the main game, but a completely different experience set in the same universe. In this game, you’ll take on the role of a quality control inspector on a production line, reviewing dolls, boxes, and items from the main game. Your job is to detect errors — for example, if a doll like Ivy from the House map arrives in a circus-themed box, you'll need to identify the mismatch. You'll analyze packaging, scan barcodes, and ensure each item meets the correct standards. This game includes a customizer and stays updated with new content from the main game. It will be available on Steam for around $4.99.

notes.title: WORKING ON UPDATE 12 [VR UPDATE]
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone for keeping up with the development of Doll Impostor!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922238/741ffce45f4de17cfd25bcfec00f9a80fb3216cf.png

Before continuing, I'd like to share a reflection: when I first launched Doll Impostor, I didn't expect to update it as much, just like some of my other games. However, this game had something that made me want to update it passionately (even before it became the best-selling game). Because of this, at some point, I realized it was more of an Early Access than a finished game. However, by then, it was already too late for Steam to classify it as Early Access (+6 months), and I understand that. 

With this in mind, I want to clarify that the game will continue to receive updates as if it were in Early Access, and I'll design a strategy to promote it as a full release when it's ready, probably by launching a free prelude on Steam :)

Remember that the development of updates will be funded through Patreon! You can join here!

You can follow the progress on Trello

Now, let's talk about the new features in this update.

Daily Multiplier Reward
Each new day you log in to play, your consecutive days count will increase. There will be a money multiplier based on how many days you've played. For example: 10,000 coins per day, if you play for 5 consecutive days, you'll earn 50,000 coins on the 5th day. Players with over 40 consecutive days will receive 400,000 coins per day. If someone reaches 100 consecutive days, they will get 1 million coins per day! :O

Loot Drop
A system will be implemented to drop items from the career mode when a player dies. This will allow teammates to recover the belongings of fallen players who were eliminated by the robot.

Easter Egg Achievements
A sequence of hidden items will be introduced (they must be collected in order) to complete the hidden dolls achievement. These items will emit a faint sound and will be well hidden throughout the maps. Additionally, since they must be collected sequentially, if you haven't collected the previous doll from another map, the next one might not appear.

Money Achievements
New achievements will be added based on the amount of money currently owned.

Extras
Additional items will be available for purchase in the refuge, such as: the radio, the Guess Who room, and a robot that will patrol your safe zone (in the future, customization options for the robot might be added).

Expansion
The house expansion will continue by adding more elements such as lights, TVs, blood effects, music, etc., similar to what was done with the organization (with the goal of fully utilizing the classic mode house).

Guestbook
A guestbook will be added to your refuge, where players you play with can leave a signature.

Co-op Time Trial
The time trial mode will be adapted for multiplayer.

VR Adaptation
As the highlight of this update, VR adaptation will be introduced! Some of you have already tried playing in VR using third-party tools, but now it will be officially supported, including proper input!

Weekly Tasks
A weekly task system will be introduced, featuring a set of collective challenges to complete throughout the week.

Official Content Creators
The official content creators program will be launched. You can check the requirements and benefits here.

Additionally, Twitch Drops will be implemented.

notes.title: WORKING ON UPDATE 11!
notes.notes:
It's time to continue development! After nearly 4 months since the announcement of multiplayer development, we have finally completed Update 10 today!

Now it’s time to move on to new things!

Remember, you can follow the development of updates on Trello:
https://trello.com/b/0DFFap5d/doll-impostor-community-issues

As well as videos that will be published on Patreon!
https://www.patreon.com/c/HeadArrow

Some of the most important features this new update will bring:


 Entity
 Buy customizable items
 Improved Career Mode
 Doll cards


Entity
The Entity will be a kind of ghost roaming the maps. It will sit in a chair waiting for the right moment to move and patrol. You’ll need to avoid it to safely inspect the dolls. If the Entity sees you, it will chase you until it catches you, and when it does, it will kill you. In multiplayer, a player who dies will no longer be needed to continue the investigation.

This can be enabled/disabled from the panel (just like jumpscares).

Buy customizable items
Starting with the next update, all customization will cost money. This adds more value and purpose to the money earned in the game.

Improved Career Mode
The Career Mode will be made more dynamic. Although there were plans to move Career Mode to classic maps, for now, it will remain in the current map with the current actions and dolls. The Entity will also be added here.

The highlight is that the tutorial will be removed, replaced with a to-do list. You’ll only need to discover a few key details about the dolls per case instead of every single piece of information (only what’s requested on the to-do list).

Doll cards
It’s too early to provide details since this feature will involve Steam’s item market. As with the trading cards, this will be our first time tackling something like this, so we’re unsure how complicated it might be. The goal is to release items on the Steam Market that can be bought and sold. These items will include collectible cards for each doll, potentially including legendary cards. These cards will be collected in an album located in your shelter, along with packs to obtain new cards!

In the future, we plan to implement something similar but using in-game currency!

Thank you so much for staying tuned!

notes.title: UPDATE #10 [MULTIPLAYER UPDATE]
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Thank you for keeping up with *Doll Impostor*! It's finally here! At last, we have *Doll Impostor* in multiplayer!

[previewyoutube=UmGHSJQvJwQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The official version will be available on November 30th, but for those who want to try the multiplayer mode now, you can use the beta "beta - beta" in Steam's beta options. It's important to share your feedback as soon as possible to help us fix any potential issues!

I remind you that the development has been documented every day on Patreon!

Currently, there are a few known bugs. They're minor but worth keeping in mind.

This update took about a full month of development, so it may have various errors. Major bugs have already been addressed in the closed beta, but please be aware of this.

Additionally, in the upcoming updates before the release date, I plan to develop Chat, Voice Chat, and an improved scare system, which will focus solely on scaring individual players rather than globally.

Multiplayer!  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922238/d3a239e05a38002ad087916a54de9de5309f1711.png  
Every time you visit your refuge, it will be open for your friends to join and/or for you to invite them. The refuge will act as the online lobby. Only the host can select a game, and your friends will also be able to see all your dolls, trophies, and the customization of your refuge and caravan!

Currently, two modes are unavailable in Multiplayer mode:  
  
 Time Trial  
 Endless  
  

However, I plan to expand the Time Trial mode and possibly create an exclusive multiplayer Endless mode.

The Career mode is also available; now you can open and solve cases together.

Doll Who  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922238/13aa932406ac442fd45f559fbe56bc250ffa09e0.png  
I've created a small board game in the new refuge room. Now you can play *Doll Who*, a classic game where you guess who someone is thinking about!

Safezone  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922238/a4c898eb38d07398046dfebeb79639ab9d13706c.png

notes.title: WORKING ON UPDATE #10 [CO-OP UPDATE]
notes.notes:
Thank you all very much for keeping up with Doll Impostor and sorry for the inactivity. I’ve been focused on other projects that have taken some time, along with vacations, but now I’m ready to get back to a few updates!

Before starting, I want to remind you that the last release we are making is Roulette Stories!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3250300/Roulette_Stories/

This game is based on stories and conversations generated entirely with offline Artificial Intelligence. You can imagine your own conversation, create characters, etc. I also started another game called Cognitio, which I will resume in 2025, along with other projects I have planned for 2025.

I remind you that you can access the pre-launch version of Roulette Stories and future games by becoming a Patreon!

CO-OP
First, we will start with a lite version of co-op, which will bring some basic things such as basic multiplayer gameplay + Steam lobby invitations (Your Shelter will be the Lobby) and you will be able to see the host’s decorations, including the caravan in each map (1-4 players) [Initially, only the host will be able to interact with the computer].

Additionally, there will be a small mini-game (Guess who) with dolls in your shelter!

In future updates, more content will be added to co-op, such as: Chat, Voice chat, Session search, Create public sessions with filters, Join them, etc.!

The reason for splitting the CO-OP updates is to ensure there aren’t too many open fronts in case problems arise.

Initially, this first version of CO-OP should be ready in beta mode by November, depending on the workload I have recently.

FUTURE UPDATES

Impostor Mode
I also plan to release a new game mode alongside Classic and Race, which will be the “Impostor” mode. This mode will be 3 players against 1 impostor. The basic gameplay would be:

1. An impostor is chosen automatically among the 4 players.
2. The impostor is randomized (like a regular match).
3. The screen indicates who the impostor is (for all players).
4. A turn-based game begins, first at 00:00, the impostor starts to carry out their strategy (having a few seconds to do so) while the investigators are asleep.
5. When the time reaches 0, the impostor (Player) won’t be able to do anything, only watch what happens around.
6. The investigators must now analyze the evidence and discard options to identify the impostor. If they don’t close the door, the player can escape and eliminate them.
7. Once the investigators’ turn ends (also timed), they all must sleep. When they sleep, the next hour will pass, and they’ll be in the caravan while the impostor can move again.
8. By voting, the investigators can make their final decision about who the impostor is during any hour in their turn. This would end the game as a win or loss depending on whether they were correct.
9. Once finished, a new round will start with a new impostor (who wasn’t previously chosen).
10. If all players have already played as impostor, there will be a vote to either replay the map or choose a different one.

Some details of this new mode include that the impostor will have limitations based on their character. For example, they may be a character that doesn’t like to move, so they won’t be able to relocate, or if they don’t like to move others, they won’t be able to move other dolls. This will be based on each map’s criteria.

Even if the investigators set traps, the impostor will be forced to react, possibly automatically.

Cabin in the Woods
The map that was announced when the last one was released will come with all the new content, meaning it will be adapted for Halloween events, Race Mode, Impostor Mode, etc.

Also, the previous Leaderboard winner, Phat, named Bamico as the next doll, so it’s still pending. Another competition will be held in the new map to determine the name of the next map’s doll (probably the toy factory).

This is expected in 2024, but there are new modes and maps planned for 2025!

As you know, if you have any feedback for improvements or ideas for new modes, they are more than welcome!

Have you ever wondered where the information about the dolls comes from?

Our new job is precisely about that, finding the information about the dolls before determining who the impostor is. To do this, we will have to use various objects to reveal these identities for each of the dolls.

IMPORTANT: Career mode is unlocked if you have a home on nightmare difficulty in classic mode

Economy

Randomization
Each doll, name, alias, preferences, relationships, location, ratio, costs, mystery box probability, impostor, etc., is completely random and varies with each new case.

Cases
In this new career mode, you will have to evaluate certain cases and accept the one that suits you best. Each resolved case will provide precise details of everything that happened, rewards, and level-ups.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44922238/18a53cf5f72f904155c2498cc650c213ec172620.gif

Mystery Box
Depending on the case, there is a chance to obtain this mystery box. The box may contain some items that can save you from having to buy them, tools, or even treasures.

Multiple items are available through the store, take advantage when costs are very low to make your purchases.

You can also sell whatever you want.

This is not a one-time adventure; it will be very common to have to enter and exit the location, return to the shelter, buy and craft some things, and then return to the location. You can travel as many times as needed, without penalty.

Five new stats and 14 new achievements have been added, some of which are synced to the statistics.

Purpose
The large amount of new content and what solving a case can entail may be overwhelming, so I recommend playing in short sessions. For example, get the necessary items and solve only one doll, then come back later to solve another or similar. Keep in mind that you have to solve the information for 20 dolls, and with the developer's speed, this can take between 1.5 and 2 hours. Therefore, new players might take many more hours or even days.

This mode has a clear precedent and is paving the way for the upcoming multiplayer mode in the next update. The idea is that each team member will have a specific role, and various tasks can be divided, such as:

Thank you all so much for continuing to support *Doll Impostor*! Finally, after a month and a half, I'm bringing you Update 8. It has been an extensive update full of challenges and complexities, so here’s a summary of the new features added in this update.

Before we begin, I want to remind you that everything is documented daily on Patreon! For those who want to support the project or my work, I appreciate your help!

PATREON

IMPORTANT, FOR THOSE USERS WHO HAVE LOST THEIR PROGRESS DUE TO STEAM CLOUD NOT SAVING CORRECTLY, THIS FILE WILL HELP YOU, IT COMES DIRECTLY FROM THE OFFICIAL DISCORD CHANNEL! (26.77 KB)
SAVE FILE

You can play this update from the beta - beta (Right-click on Doll Impostor -> Properties -> Betas -> beta - beta) but remember that it may have bugs, and this is the purpose of releasing the beta—to find these bugs and fix them before the general public encounters them.


 Leveling System
 Economy System
 Career Mode
 Cases
 Store
 Weapons and Items
 New and Random Dolls for Each Case
 Crafting and Recipe System


Before starting with the update, I want to clarify that I have not implemented the procedural map. Although the system was challenging to develop and integrate, I ultimately found it difficult to conceptualize and fit this type of map into *Doll Impostor*. The fusion between the exterior and interior was very challenging to carry out, both practically and philosophically. In the end, I wasn't satisfied with the result, so the maps will remain static within their locations.

Please keep in mind that this new mode can be very overwhelming since there is a lot of work to do. While I know a user can handle it solo, it’s a lot to manage. This is intentional, as the next update will bring a more substantial co-op element. Working in a team will be much more beneficial for solving cases.


Classic Mode
Classic Mode has not been altered beyond adding money and level rewards for playing. This is useful because in Career Mode, you will need money for various things, and you can earn it by playing Classic Mode.

Leveling System
The leveling system works logarithmically and is detailed in some Patreon posts. Some items require a certain level, and as you increase your level, some aspects of the game will become more challenging.


 Natural Progression: You earn roughly the same XP per game, so the higher your level, the more you’ll need to play to level up.
 Information: The information about the dolls is related to your level; the higher your level, the less information you get. There's also a parameter called the ratio, visible in each case, where a higher ratio means less possible information.


Economy System
This will be updated further, but you now have an economy. You can buy items and perform various actions that require money, such as finding a new case.

Career Mode
Career Mode arises from the need to explain the information we’ve already received in our adventures. We've always searched for an impostor with pre-existing information, but where does this information come from? Who provided it? Well, now we know: it was you, investigating the terrain and the dolls' information beforehand. That's why you know all this information and are so familiar with the dolls.

Career Mode is the focus of this update. It brings a single case, which already has prepared dolls, actions, likes, dislikes, an impostor, and a series of factors like location, ratio, whether prices are high or low, etc.

Career Mode aims to overcome cases indefinitely with random dolls, etc.

Cases
Cases are varied and will be saved in your case history. In the current case, you can do various things like turn on the electricity, photograph all the dolls, and use elements to discover the dolls' information.

You can travel as many times as you want for a modest amount of money, and each day you travel will be recorded in your case.

There’s also a score and ranking obtained for each case; I know many of you will aim to get S++ in all your cases.

Store
The store is an essential resource. Here, you can buy ingredients to make elixirs, soul papers, flashlights, cameras, etc.

Almost everything that involves interacting with the world will need to be acquired through the store.

Weapons and Items
Many of you have repeatedly requested some weapons like a flashlight. I consider any item that can be equipped in the game to be a weapon. The flashlight isn't the only weapon; there's also a camera, fuse, bag, notebook, lighter, elixirs, etc.

Each weapon has a purpose that can be utilized. The important thing here is to lay the groundwork for future integrations.

New and Random Dolls
I've added around 86 new dolls, a number greater than the current 60 dolls already in the game. These dolls are only available in Career Mode and will never have original names since they will be used to represent infinite dolls.

Initially, I considered creating a procedural or slightly procedural doll, but I ultimately discarded that idea and implemented this number of new dolls.

These dolls have random names, aliases, likes, dislikes, friends, enemies, hatreds, and loves for each case.

Crafting and Recipe System
Along with the store, the crafting and recipe system is very useful, especially at lower levels, as you will need to craft various elixirs, soul papers, and some items to use within the location.

There are currently about 10 modest recipes, and they are extremely necessary for discovering information.

notes.title: Working on Update 8!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! As you already know, I am working on the future co-op mode for the game, planning how it should be and what things it will need. However, it wouldn't be very entertaining with the current mode, so this update will be much larger than the previous ones. It will not yet have the co-op mode, but it will have the new game mode called "Career." This mode is an evolution of Doll Impostor that will include Economy, Levels, Experience, and Items. The final idea of this mode is to solve a case each time, hence why this update is called "Cases Update."

This update aims to offer a more unique experience each time. This will be vital for the co-op version so that you and your friends can find all the clues and solve the case together.

The goal is to have procedural maps with completely different and much more generic dolls than the current ones, so that, for example, only the appearance changes but all have the same pose.

What does it consist of?
You will have some random cases to solve. These cases will appear every time you enter the safe zone. Once a case is selected, you cannot choose another; you will have to finish it or abandon it. Before identifying the impostor, you will have to discover the behaviors. Once you discover some of them, you will have to mark them, as well as the information of each doll, including the photographs. Each clue you find will give you money and experience in your case, which will be delivered at the end. When you have all the clues you need, you can start the hunt.

Reasons to choose a case
The map will change with each case, as will the information given and the reward for each detail discovered and for the impostor discovered.

Abandoning a case
Every time you abandon a case, you will be financially penalized.

Discovering behaviors
This part is vital and is proportionally dependent on your level in the game. The higher the level, the less information will be available. For this, the items come into play, where you will have to use them together to identify the details of the dolls. An example of this could be a book of souls, which after a ritual allows you to possess the body of one of the dolls. Activate your traps and return later. When you return, you will see what this doll did and can note the missing clues.

Hunt
With all the clues in your favor (it is highly recommended), you will have to return to the place, place a book of souls on the spot, and sleep. This will immediately start a classic game, but all the clues obtained will be your clues. If you discover the impostor, you will receive 100% of the reward. If you don't succeed, you will receive 50% of everything accumulated.

Economy
The economy will be a vital point in this new mode. When you win a classic game, depending on the difficulty, it will give you more or less money. This will be useful for doing various things in career mode.

Levels and Experience
Levels and experience will be saved in your statistics. The higher the level, the less information you will have, but the more information you get, the greater the reward.

Items
It is still too early to confirm the items, but some of the key ones would be:

 Book of Souls: This is the most important since it allows you to possess a doll to perform an action.
 Notebook: This is also extremely important as you will mark the names of the dolls on the list.
 Camera: The camera will also be an important element to photograph each doll to have it on your panel.
 Fuse: This item will be necessary to activate electrical things (may require multiple fuses).
 Flashlight: This item will also be key because you won't have any light points.


These are just some of the ideas in mind, but they do not necessarily have to be the final result. The most important thing about this update is that it aims to be a truly unique experience each time and to maintain the previous ones, in fact, merging them in the sense that you will earn money in classic mode. This update is very necessary to provide very unique experiences when you play with friends each time. It is undoubtedly one of the most complex and elaborate updates that Doll Impostor will have, but I think that after the successful development of this, the next step would be to provide the co-op experience.

I want to emphasize that the original mode will remain exactly the same as always; this is an addition to the game, not a replacement.

notes.title: UPDATE #4 [CIRCUS UPDATE]
notes.notes:
Thank you all so much for keeping up with the updates! These past few weeks have been very tough for me, but thanks to this update, the content has more than doubled. This game is growing by leaps and bounds, all thanks to your support! 🎉

It is already available in beta mode, look in the steam betas for one called "beta" (Need steam restart to show) and it will have the update, however it may have bugs, please report as soon as possible the bugs you find!

I am pleased to announce that the circus map is now available! 🎪 This update brings new jumpscares, a new place to view the board, a ton of new actions, new traps, and 20 new dolls!

[previewyoutube=_0LhanNIYVI;full][/previewyoutube]


Safe House
First of all, let's start with the new area (The Safe Zone). This area is your home, where you live and store the dolls you collect. You also have a new companion, a caravan, where you live or conduct your research (from now on with new maps). This area will continue to expand and create new spaces! 🏡

New Modes!
A tutorial has been implemented that everyone will need to complete (it won't take more than a minute for the most experienced players). This will be a great starting point for new players. The difficulty levels have also been adjusted to better match their specific challenges, and they are as follows:


 Easy
 Normal
 Hard
 Nightmare

Achievements for these difficulties have been reset. You will need to reach Normal difficulty to play the circus map! 🎪

Now, the Easy difficulty will be what was previously "Normal." You start at 00:00, have a list of names and actions of the impostor, and all clues are revealed at 08:00.

Normal difficulty starts at 00:00 but without extra clues, and you can't see the list or names.

Difficult difficulty starts at 06:00. You won't be able to see the photos of the dolls, and there will be no extra clues.

Nightmare difficulty starts at 08:00. It has 3 effective clues (these are now effective, so there won't be clues like "doesn't like light or TV"), no photos, no help, and some of the doll information is hidden (showing "????????" on some items). Additionally, you have limited access to the map.

 Random: This mode is like Normal, but the information about the dolls is completely random.
 Race: This mode is like Random, but you have 3 minutes to solve the case. Depending on your speed, you'll earn a bronze, silver, or gold medal (earning a higher medal will also grant you the lower ones). These are three new achievements per map.
 Endless: This mode is like Career, but when you win, another round starts immediately. If you fail, you lose immediately as well.
Additionally, a leaderboard has been added for each map in Endless mode, tracking the number of nights completed.


Circus 🎪
The circus map brings a ton of new features, including those already mentioned. Additionally, it introduces a specific action called "Confuse." If the impostor likes to confuse, they can perform this action (only once per night). However, they will be able to choose something they don't like and do it.

notes.title: UPDATE 3 [MOMMY UPDATE]
notes.notes:
I'm pleased to announce that Update 3 is finally ready. This is a major update due to the large number of modifications and fixes. It's also special due to the integration of two new members into the household, they are Mom and Billy (her son), the house's dolls are owned by Mom.

In this house, a family of three lived happily: Dad, Mom, and Billy. Mom was an excellent woman, very religious and she loved collecting porcelain and wooden dolls. Her great collection ended up in the living room.

Unfortunately, this is not a pretty story. Something terrible happened to the family; Mom ended Dad's life and poor Billy, scared, was fleeing from Mom for hours until she finally caught him. Mom also ended his life. Close sources claim, "Mom would have never done such a thing, something terrible must have happened to her, probably related to demons and evil spirits."
